priority_1_stringing.rationale: Stage 8 found FNR=0.898 on one PURE_FAILING stringing test recording. The training set has 23 stringing recordings (2341 frames), but 4 have <10 frames and date diversity is concentrated (22122022, 14.02.2023).

minimum_exploratory.rationale: 5-10 new independent sessions would roughly double the session count. Each session should come from a distinct print job (different dates if possible) to test generalization beyond the existing date clusters.

stronger_target.rationale: Would bring total stringing sessions to ~40+, approaching the diversity level of under_extrusion (37 train sessions). Provides meaningful coverage of session-to-session variation.

ideal_target.note: Would bring total to ~50+ sessions, matching or exceeding under_extrusion diversity. This is a production-grade target, not a minimum exploratory target.

diversity_requirements: Different print stages where stringing occurs
Mix of severe and mild stringing
priority_1_stringing.held_out_condition: Hold out 1-2 sessions from a distinct date range or object as a final held-out set, separate from the existing frozen test set.

priority_2_normal_domain.rationale: Recording_20122022_17_05_36 is a PURE_NORMAL test recording with brightness ~76 vs training normal ~156. This represents a potentially missing normal condition (darker lighting or different camera setting).

minimum_exploratory.note: Capture normal prints under varied lighting: bright, dim, and mixed ambient conditions. Include sessions that test the model's ability to reject non-failure visual variation.

stronger_target.note: Cover at least 3 distinct lighting/environment conditions.

diversity_requirements: Different camera orientations/angles if eventually relevant

priority_3_spaghetti.rationale: Spaghetti has only 5 training recordings (191 frames) and 4 validation recordings (49 frames). This is the scarcest failure type.

minimum_exploratory.note: Spaghetti is visually distinctive but severely underrepresented.

stronger_target.note: Would bring total to ~15-20 sessions, comparable to stringing.

priority_4_under_extrusion.rationale: Under_extrusion has 37 training recordings (3331 frames) — the best-represented failure type. Additional data is lower priority but could improve generalization at the margins.

minimum_exploratory.note: Focus on under-represented severity levels or object types.

general_principles: Prioritize INDEPENDENT SESSIONS over raw frame count.
Each new session should be from a distinct print job, ideally on a different date.
Record metadata: date, object, lighting condition, camera settings if available.
Label requirements: same binary normal/failing + fine failure type as existing.
Split strategy: new sessions split 60/20/20 by session (not frame) into train/val/held-out.
The existing frozen test set remains untouched for evaluation.
Held-out sessions from new data provide a second evaluation set to measure improvement.

future_experiment.objective: Test whether adding targeted independent data improves generalization to previously unseen recordings.

old_test_set.policy: FROZEN. Do not touch. Used only for final comparison.

new_data_split_policy.held_out_set: Sessions from new data held out at acquisition time; these become the second evaluation set to measure improvement.

primary_metrics: FNR on stringing failure type (test set, at threshold 0.65)
FPR on normal frames (test set, at threshold 0.65)
F1 overall (test set, at threshold 0.50 and 0.65)
secondary_metrics: Performance on the new held-out evaluation set

success_criteria.minimum: Stringing FNR improves by >=5pp on the frozen test set, without F1 regression on other failure types.
success_criteria.meaningful: Stringing FNR improves by >=10pp AND overall F1 improves by >=1pp on the frozen test set.
success_criteria.strong: Stringing FNR on the frozen test set approaches under_extrusion FNR (currently 0.155), and the new held-out set shows comparable performance.

deliverables: Updated frozen checkpoint (retrained with expanded training set)
Same frozen test set evaluation at 0.50 and 0.65

retraining_gate.B_what_evidence_or_data_is_missing:
1. The current training set has adequate under_extrusion coverage (37 sessions) but stringing is concentrated in date clusters (22122022, 14.02.2023) with some tiny sessions (2-24 frames). Adding 5-10 new independent stringing sessions before retraining would test whether the model can learn stringing from diverse sessions, not just from the current date clusters.
2. The normal-domain false-alarm problem (Recording_20122022_17_05_36, brightness ~76 vs training ~156) suggests the training normal set may not cover darker lighting conditions. 5-10 normal sessions under varied lighting would test this.
3. Spaghetti is severely underrepresented (5 training sessions, 191 frames). Adding 5-8 sessions would bring it closer to stringing's diversity.
retraining_gate.C_what_data_acquisition_unblocks_retrain: Minimum: 5-10 new independent stringing sessions (50-200 frames each) from distinct print jobs and dates. Optionally: 5-10 normal sessions under varied lighting, and 5-8 spaghetti sessions.
retraining_gate.D_what_would_constitute_success:
After retraining with the expanded dataset:
- Stringing FNR on the frozen test set improves by >=5pp (ideally >=10pp).
- Overall test F1 does not regress.
- The new held-out evaluation set shows comparable performance to the frozen test.
- Calibration does not materially degrade.
- No single recording dominates the error profile.
priority_order: 1. Independent session diversity (not raw frame count)
5. Raw frame count (lowest priority — more of the same sessions adds little)

limitations: All analyses are metadata/statistical only; no model inference was performed.
Image statistics (brightness, contrast) are non-learned proxies, not proof of semantic OOD.
Frame counts are not independent samples; recording identity is the diversity unit.
Test-set observations are documented for context only; they do not drive data-selection decisions.
No claims of real-world generalization are made.
